enforcedBy: the naming gate, which refuses a filename whose last segment before the extension is an undeclared tag or differs from its folder's tag

check.population: every filename whose concern slot holds the tag, and the folder holding each such file
check.freshness: a verdict stands until a file carrying the tag is created, moved or renamed, or the declared vocabulary changes
check.refusal: the lint run fails a file whose tag is undeclared or disagrees with its folder
check.observation: each filename parsed by position against the declared concern vocabulary
check.evidence: fires-and-accepts: a suite lints a file whose tag is undeclared and one whose tag differs from its folder, and passes a conforming file
check.authority: the declared concern vocabulary, which a filename's tag and its folder conform to

records.name: Test Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the compound marker for a file that exercises another file and asserts on the outcome, which is exempt from the naming grammar and placed in its subject's mirrored concern folder.

records.name: Suite Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that groups related test cases under one setup, filed in a suites folder.

records.name: Case Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that holds the inputs and expected outcomes one test runs, filed in a cases folder.

records.name: Fixture Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that provides the known state or samples a test starts from, filed in a fixtures folder.

records.name: Mock Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that stands in for a collaborator and records how it was called, filed in a mocks folder.

records.name: Fake Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that implements a collaborator in a simpler working form for tests, filed in a fakes folder.

records.name: Stub Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that returns fixed answers in place of a collaborator, filed in a stubs folder.

records.name: Spy Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that wraps a real collaborator and records its calls, filed in a spies folder.

records.name: Double Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that replaces a collaborator in a test when no narrower double names its role, filed in a doubles folder.

records.name: Assertion Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines reusable checks tests apply to outcomes, filed in an assertions folder.

records.name: Harness Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that sets up and drives the environment a subject is tested in, filed in a harnesses folder.

records.name: Runner Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that discovers and runs a set of tests or tasks and collects their results, filed in a runners folder.

records.name: Coverage Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that measures which parts of a subject its tests reach, filed in a coverage folder.

records.name: Reference Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file of authored knowledge a reader consults, such as a guide or a note, filed in a references folder.

records.name: View Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that renders one screen or page from the state it is given, filed in a views folder.

records.name: Component Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that renders one reusable piece of interface with its own inputs, filed in a components folder.

records.name: Widget Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that renders one interactive control, filed in a widgets folder.

records.name: Layout Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that arranges regions of an interface without deciding their contents, filed in a layouts folder.

records.name: Template Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that holds a shape with slots that are filled to produce an output, filed in a templates folder.

records.name: Theme Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that selects one coherent set of visual values for a whole interface, filed in a themes folder.

records.name: Style Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that holds the presentation rules for one surface, filed in a styles folder.

records.name: Tokens Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the collection tag for a file that declares named design values such as colors and spacing, plural in both folder and tag.

records.name: Strings Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the collection tag for a file that holds the user-visible text a surface displays, plural in both folder and tag.

records.name: Accessibility Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that makes an interface usable through assistive technology, filed in an accessibility folder.

records.name: Command Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines one command a command-line or chat surface accepts, filed in a commands folder.

records.name: Prompt Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that asks a participant for input and validates the answer, filed in a prompts folder.

records.name: Printer Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that writes a command surface's output to a terminal, filed in a printers folder.

records.name: Renderer Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that draws frames to a display from a scene or a model, filed in a renderers folder.

records.name: Shader Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that holds a program the graphics processor runs per vertex or per pixel, filed in a shaders folder.

records.name: Material Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines how a surface reflects light and which textures it uses, filed in a materials folder.

records.name: Sprite Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines a two-dimensional image drawn and moved as one object, filed in a sprites folder.

records.name: Atlas Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that packs many images into one texture with the coordinates of each, filed in an atlases folder.

records.name: Geometry Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the mass tag for a file that holds shapes as vertices and faces, singular in both folder and tag.

records.name: Camera Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines the viewpoint and projection a scene is seen through, filed in a cameras folder.

records.name: Viewport Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines the region of a display a camera draws into, filed in a viewports folder.

records.name: Frame Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines one rendered image in a sequence and what it contains, filed in a frames folder.

records.name: Effect Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that adds visual or audio feedback to an event without changing the state behind it, filed in an effects folder.

records.name: Particle Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that simulates many small short-lived elements such as sparks or smoke, filed in a particles folder.

records.name: Telegraph Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that signals an action before it lands so a participant can react, filed in a telegraphs folder.

records.name: Respawn Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that returns a removed participant or object to the world under stated rules, filed in a respawn folder.
